newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.1 bln for Wednesday, March 19.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.1 bln for Wednesday, March 19.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, March 19 are expected to total $1.1 billion in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $794 million in 20 sales, with a $125 million Pennsylvania Higher Educational deal through Mellon Financial Markets, Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 10 sales totaling $289 million are on the schedule, a $226 million Louisiana deal at 1100 EST is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $62 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday, depending on market conditions.
